chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah have mercy on them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh and al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā and Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim together, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicating that both named transmitters narrated from the same shaykh
key_terms.رَحِمَهُمَا اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on them both; a supplicatory expression for the deceased
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formula indicating direct authorial transmission
key_terms.عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ: From ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb; identifies the endpoint of this transmission path

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and establishing the source pathway for the hadith material.
